```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)


input_file <- file.path("data_processed", "NZ_FR_IAR_final_dataset.parquet")
report_minimums <- c(1L, 2L, 3L, 4L,5L, 6L, 10L, 20L)

# read in the final dataset, filter mmi
iar <- read_parquet(input_file) |> as_tibble()
iar <- iar |>
  mutate(origintime = as.POSIXct(origintime, tz = "UTC")) |>
  filter(
    between(reported_mmi, 3, 8),
    is.finite(Mw),
    Mw >= 3.5,
    origintime >= as.POSIXct("2016-09-01", tz = "UTC")
  )

median_or_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else median(x)
}
```
\newpage
```{r}
events <- iar |>
  group_by(publicid) |>
  summarise(
    Mw = first(Mw),
    depth_km = first(event_depth_km),
    n_cells = n(),
    total_reports = sum(as.double(report_count)),
    distance_span_km = max(Repi_km) - min(Repi_km),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
counts <- events |> select(total_reports, n_cells) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "measure", values_to = "count") |>
  mutate(measure = recode(measure, total_reports = "Reports", n_cells = "Spatial cells"))
p <- ggplot(counts, aes(count)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "green", colour = "white") +
  scale_x_log10() + facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Count per earthquake (log scale)", y = "Earthquakes", title = "Reports and Cells per Earthquake")
p
```
\newpage
```{r}
threshold_summary <- map_dfr(report_minimums, function(minimum) {
  x <- events |> filter(total_reports >= minimum)
  tibble(minimum_reports = minimum,
    earthquakes_percent = 100 * nrow(x) / nrow(events),
    cells_percent = 100 * sum(x$n_cells) / nrow(iar),
    reports_percent = 100 * sum(x$total_reports) / sum(as.double(iar$report_count)),
    median_cells = median_or_na(x$n_cells), median_distance_span_km = median_or_na(x$distance_span_km),
    single_cell_percent = if (nrow(x) == 0) NA_real_ else 100 * mean(x$n_cells == 1),
    median_Mw = median_or_na(x$Mw), median_depth_km = median_or_na(x$depth_km))
})
retention <- threshold_summary |>
  select(minimum_reports, earthquakes_percent, cells_percent, reports_percent) |>
  pivot_longer(-minimum_reports, names_to = "unit", values_to = "percent") |>
  mutate(unit = recode(unit, earthquakes_percent = "Earthquakes",
                      cells_percent = "Earthquake-cell rows", reports_percent = "Reports"))
p <- ggplot(retention, aes(minimum_reports, percent, colour = unit)) + geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = report_minimums) +
  labs(x = "Minimum total reports per earthquake", y = "Retained (%)", colour = NULL,
       title = "Retention by Report Minimum")
p
```
\newpage
```{r}
coverage <- threshold_summary |>
  select(-ends_with("_percent"), single_cell_percent) |>
  pivot_longer(-minimum_reports, names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(measure = recode(measure, median_cells = "Median spatial cells",
    median_distance_span_km = "Median distance span (km)", single_cell_percent = "Single-cell events (%)",
    median_Mw = "Median Mw", median_depth_km = "Median depth (km)"))
p <- ggplot(coverage, aes(minimum_reports, value)) + geom_line(na.rm = TRUE) + geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = report_minimums) + facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(x = "Minimum total reports per earthquake", y = NULL, title = "Event coverage by report minimum")
p
```

```{r}
mmi_scores <- 3:8
mmi_counts <- iar |> group_by(reported_mmi) |>
  summarise(`Earthquake-cell rows` = n(), `Earthquakes represented` = n_distinct(publicid), .groups = "drop") |>
  complete(reported_mmi = mmi_scores, fill = list(`Earthquake-cell rows` = 0L, `Earthquakes represented` = 0L)) |>
  pivot_longer(-reported_mmi, names_to = "unit", values_to = "count")
p <- ggplot(mmi_counts, aes(factor(reported_mmi, levels = mmi_scores), count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "green") + facet_wrap(~ unit, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Cell median MMI", y = "Count", title = "MMI score frequencies")
p
```

```{r}
event_variables <- events |> select(Mw, depth_km) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(variable = recode(variable, Mw = "Moment magnitude (Mw)", depth_km = "Depth (km)"))
centres <- event_variables |> group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(Mean = mean(value), Median = median(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(-variable, names_to = "statistic", values_to = "value")
p <- ggplot(event_variables, aes(value)) + geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "green", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(data = centres, aes(xintercept = value, linetype = statistic), colour = "orange") +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Earthquakes", linetype = NULL, title = "Magnitude and depth distributions")
p
```

  ) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Earthquake locations", colour = "Mw") +
  guides(size = "none") +
  theme_minimal()
p

```{r vs30_maps, fig.width=9, fig.height=11}
r <- rast("data_raw/vs30/foster_2019_vs30_median.tif")
crs(r) <- "EPSG:2193"

plot(r, col=hcl.colors(100, "viridis"),
     main="New Zealand Vs30 (m/s)", axes=FALSE)

sites <- iar |>
  distinct(report_longitude, report_latitude, .keep_all = TRUE)

pts <- vect(sites, geom=c("report_longitude", "report_latitude"),
            crs="EPSG:4326") |> project(crs(r))

direct <- extract(r, pts)[[2]]

sites$status <- case_when(
  !is.finite(sites$Vs30_m_s) ~ "Missing",
  !is.finite(direct) | abs(sites$Vs30_m_s-direct) > 0.001 ~ "Substituted",
  TRUE ~ "Original"
)

plot(r, col=gray.colors(30, 0.95, 0.70),
     legend=FALSE, axes=FALSE,
     main="Missing and Substituted Vs30 Values")

points(pts[sites$status=="Missing", ], col="red", pch=16, cex=0.7)
points(pts[sites$status=="Substituted", ], col="blue", pch=16, cex=0.7)

legend("topleft", inset = c(0.10, 0), legend=c("Missing Vs30", "Substituted Vs30"),
       col=c("red", "blue"), pch=16, bty="n")

table(sites$status)
```
